tasks.final_text: Did you know that in the Malaysian Grand Prix in 2013, Sebastian Vettel disobeyed team orders to overtake Mark Webber in a famous incident known as the "Multi-21" controversy. Webber was leading the race and team orders were given for Vettel to hold position in second behind Webber--however, Vettel took the lead at risk to himself, Webber, and the team. This resulted in widespread anger among fans, though minimal repurcussions from the team.

Shopper's Worls is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facility (Spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
